$comment: Auxiliary tools used to publish and consume the Windows build-input bundle (#236, W1-R). Every entry is pinned by exact version AND sha256 and is verified before use. A runner-preinstalled registry client is never accepted: its identity is whatever the image happens to carry that week, which is the same rolling-input problem this whole mechanism exists to remove.

oras.why: pushes and pulls the exact precomputed OCI manifest bytes. `oras manifest push` is used rather than `oras push`, because the latter constructs its own manifest and would inject org.opencontainers.image.created.
